acceptance.assertion: A SymbolInformation object with relationships omitted or relationships: [] produces no relationship record and no relationship_source_definition_missing or ambiguous degradation, even when that symbol has no occurrence definition.

A non-list relationships value remains relationships_invalid; malformed relationship objects, targets and flags remain explicit degradations, and a non-empty relationship list without exactly one same-document source definition remains blocked.
Valid non-empty relationships with one exact same-document definition retain deterministic relationship records, source ranges and supported relationship flags.
Artifact ordering, deduplication, schema validity, provenance, consumer_enablement and default non-promotion remain unchanged except for removal of the false empty-list degradation.
The minimal reproducer, focused SCIP adapter tests, full RepoGround tests, exact-head diff-bound self-review and GitHub CI are green before merge.

approval.note: The user explicitly instructed Grabowski to implement the next safe RepoGround work. Scope is limited to one SCIP adapter behavior and its regression tests; no runtime, deployment or consumer-promotion effect is authorized.

goal: Treat an absent or empty SCIP SymbolInformation relationships collection as no relationship evidence to project, without requiring a source definition or degrading an otherwise healthy navigation artifact; preserve fail-closed degradation for malformed and non-empty relationship evidence.

metadata.scope_reason: This follow-up is disjoint from the active Bureau T014 supply work and from RepoGround T004 monolith convergence. It corrects a bounded regression introduced by the optional SCIP adapter merged in RepoGround PR #1147.
metadata.outcome: RepoGround ignores absent or empty SCIP SymbolInformation relationships without false source-definition degradation, while malformed and non-empty relationship evidence remains fail-closed.
